# Render round 3: source findings, continence (continence_supply_program_services)

Source: continence.extended.yaml sha256 61b2f0b48030496d2f6012a081039f5be80a0fc5a9cf48e13ff4497d073072fb (task_tools.py 8cf6605b…, unchanged). Upstream: VERDICT revision_6 charter=CLEAN.

## New source mismatches

None. For each of the six policies I checked every factor sentence and every standard-method / combination sentence against its compute binding. The following all agree with the compute:

- the order's excess times MN(phase, blocks), capped by the route limit;
- cushion and margin added after the replacements;
- the waived amount floored at zero, with the share capped at the whole;
- the kit units added inside the excess over the limit, then the waiver limit, then the price multiplier;
- the restocking basis replaced, then multiplied by both reliefs, then the scheduled share withheld;
- installments MX(1, term − shift), with the amount spread being the balance less the first installment.

## Rendering placement (no mismatch)

- Each computation document carries the standard method and the generic combination sentence only. The combination sentence is reworded from "Each adjustment set out below …" to "Each adjustment to … changes …" so that it does not point at other documents.
- Three overwrite sentences are not homed in a computation document:
  - The return-credit overwrite names "the restocking charge", so it is homed in the restocking-schedule factor document.
  - The refill supply-days overwrite stays in its supply-span document.
  - The open-amount overwrite stays in its deduction document.
- The neutral overwrites stay in the computation documents: refill units ("the units are those this policy states") and charge units and price.
